pipe_metric_semantics.cube_utilization_percent: Installed CANN computes aic_total_cycles / (aic_frequency * ai_core_num * task_duration) * 100 with unit conversion; mac_ratio is only checked for nonzero, not multiplied. It measures kernel-local core activity/occupancy, not MAC pipeline efficiency or model MFU.
pipe_metric_semantics.mac_fraction: sum(aic_mac_time(us)) / sum(aicore_time(us)) for rows with positive aicore_time; a kernel-local pipe-time ratio, not whole-step FLOP utilization.
pipe_metric_semantics.aggregation: Cube percentage is weighted by duration of measured kernels of the same type/core. Kernels may overlap; no per-type values are added as wall time. Missing exported columns are listed explicitly.

device_gaps.definition: No recorded compute or communication inside each step's first-to-last kernel envelope; endpoints excluded.

communication_detail.limits: Time-info zero values may mean incomplete plane coverage, not no transfer/wait. SDMA aggregates other links; do not add it to HCCS. Subtask summed time is not elapsed critical-path transfer time.
